title: Make canonical GitHub Actions workflows portable through Buildkite migration
intent: Keep .github/workflows/*.yml as the sole workflow contract while adding explicit, documented compatibility paths for Buildkite GHA execution. Preserve native GitHub Actions behavior, preserve event and release gates, and make adapter limitations observable through workflow diagnostics rather than adding a second native Buildkite pipeline.
proof_hooks: Dedicated Buildkite compatibility PR checks pass for docs push, release publication push, and release planning pull request paths
stop_conditions: Do not add a second native Buildkite workflow source or remove any existing .github/workflows/*.yml gate.
Do not weaken release, publish, docs, or security gates; compatibility branches must fail with actionable diagnostics when required Buildkite inputs are missing.
deferred_questions: After Buildkite migration parity is verified for pull requests, master, releases, docs, and tags, decide when to disable the GitHub Actions service.
